newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann shares higher against the trend.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann shares higher against the trend.

text.p: Shares in German engineering group Mannesmann AG traded higher in late afternoon IBIS electronic trade on Wednesday, boosted by nine-month figures, which saw improved sales and flat orders.
In late IBIS trade Mannesmann shares were up 9.60 marks ($6.41) at 636.10 marks, while the overall IBIS DAX index was down 14.14 points, or 0.51 percent, at 2,767.40 points.
Earlier in the day, CS First Boston maintained its buy recommendation on Mannesmann.

"Earlier the buy recommendation was very compelling. Since then the engineering and capital goods are not looking so pretty. But the decline in revenue per user is not as bad as people are saying and Mannesmann is still a buy," said Niall O'Connor, CS First Boston analyst.
